coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 10 core conversational/enterprise/NL-first agent builders (Voiceflow, Coze, Wordware, Lindy, Airia, Botpress, Rasa, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Relay.app). For each product, captured: official homepage, docs/API reference, pricing page, third-party review aggregates (G2/Capterra/TrustRadius), funding records (Crunchbase/Y Combinator/PitchBook/Tracxn), changelogs, competitive teardowns, and HCI research. Swept multiple angles: (1) product-specific searches for docs/pricing/reviews; (2) cross-product comparisons (Voiceflow vs Botpress vs Rasa, etc.); (3) industry analyst coverage (Gartner Magic Quadrant for Conversational AI, Forrester Wave on Low-Code, Gartner Agentic AI Hype Cycle); (4) academic HCI research on agent builder UX/affordances (arXiv papers on agentic workflows, conversational UI design, visualization); (5) governance/security pain points (prompt injection, hallucination, enterprise governance frameworks); (6) market dynamics (funding rounds, adoption statistics). Deduplication applied across review platform coverage—consolidated multiple G2/Capterra links into primary review pages per product. Coverage includes T0 primary sources (official homepages, pricing, official docs, Gartner press releases), T1 official derivatives (GitHub repos, API docs, changelogs, analyst reports), T2 high-quality practitioner analysis (review aggregators, comparison articles, academic papers, vendor blogs), and T3 editorial (listicles, comparison guides). No significant gaps in core product coverage; academic HCI literature on agent builder UX remains sparse relative to market demand (suggests emerging HCI research opportunity).
